note: Manual override of 'Shows You Watch Together' co-watching progress, for the case where Trakt's own export data (library.json/currentlyWatching.json) is stale relative to right now - either because Bill hasn't uploaded a fresh export yet reflecting real, recent watching (Tires, below), or because he's corrected the real watched-state directly in Trakt (unmarked episodes that were wrongly bulk-marked watched) but hasn't re-exported yet (Hacks, Euphoria, below). This app has no live connection to Trakt by design (see CLAUDE.md's standing rule) - it only ever reflects whatever was in the last uploaded export zip, so a fix made directly on trakt.tv is invisible here until a fresh export is uploaded and re-imported. See build_trakt_library.js's hasConfirmedWatchDate comment for the deeper investigation into why 'fully placeholder-dated, plays==airedEpisodes' can't be trusted or distrusted by code alone (2026-09-17: 273 of 393 shows share that exact shape, most genuinely fully watched - Hacks and Euphoria are two real, Bill-confirmed exceptions, not a pattern to generalize from). Populated directly from what Bill tells us in chat, never inferred or guessed. status: 'caught-up' means treat this show as NOT ready to watch together right now, regardless of the computed episode count. status: 'behind' means treat it as ready to watch together even if Trakt's own numbers say otherwise. Clear an entry (or refresh its updatedAt) once a fresh Trakt export makes the real plays count trustworthy again for that title - none of these are meant to be permanent.
